description: A shell script for managing database migrations, resets, status checks, and backups for a sports telecast platform. It handles PostgreSQL database interactions including executing SQL files, maintaining migration history, resetting the database, and providing status reports.

methods.name: check_postgres
methods.description: Checks if PostgreSQL is running and accessible.

methods.name: run_sql_file
methods.description: Executes a given SQL file on the database.

methods.name: create_migration_table
methods.description: Creates a migration history tracking table if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: is_migration_executed
methods.description: Checks if a specific migration has already been executed successfully.

methods.name: record_migration
methods.description: Records the execution of a migration, marking success or failure.

methods.name: run_migrations
methods.description: Runs all pending database migrations in order.

methods.name: reset_database
methods.description: Drops all tables and types in the database to reset it (requires confirmation).

methods.name: show_status
methods.description: Displays database status, including tables, migration history, and row counts.

methods.name: backup_database
methods.description: Creates a backup of the entire database.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays usage instructions and environment variables.
